acceptance_criteria.statement: WHEN the regression corpus is replayed, THE SYSTEM SHALL produce output byte-identical to the pre-extraction baseline.
The existing billing integration suite passes unchanged, with no test edited or skipped.
Static analysis reports no import from the monolith into billing internals.
p95 invoice generation latency is within 105% of the recorded baseline.

constraints.statement: Reaching past the surface would recreate the coupling this work removes.

declared_edges.statement: The monolith calls billing through its published surface.

decisions.statement: Ship behind the existing release train; no separate deployment.

intent.business_outcome: Make billing logic independently testable and releasable.
intent.description: FIXTURE DATA - not product evidence. Proves the Contract Kernel works with NO AI architecture: no models, no tools, no agent runtime.
intent.name: Extract the billing calculator from the monolith

non_goals.rationale: Any behavioural change here is indistinguishable from a billing defect to downstream consumers.
non_goals.statement: Public billing behaviour must not change. This is a structural move, not a redesign.
Do not alter pricing rules, rounding or currency handling.
Do not migrate the billing database schema.

requirements.rationale: Byte-identical output is the only check strong enough to prove a pure structural move.
requirements.statement: The extracted module MUST produce byte-identical invoice output for every input in the existing regression corpus.
The monolith MUST NOT depend on internal details of the extracted module.
Invoice generation SHOULD not regress by more than 5% at p95.

scope.statement: Move billing calculation out of the monolith into its own module.
Bring the existing billing test suite with it, unchanged.

verification.description: Stored as data. This system never executes it.
verification.name: Invoice golden replay

verification.description: Compare p95 against the recorded pre-extraction baseline.
verification.name: Latency measurement
